effects: The original Abyssal Cinders Inferno activation chance is increased from 5% to 25%.
The original Barkscales Grasp activation requirement is reduced from 5 reductions to 2.
Striking Light cooldown is reduced to 4.8 seconds.
body.name: Perfidious

assumptions: The Cinders multiplier applies only to the original Abyssal Cinders trigger; it does not change Unholy Critual's guaranteed critical-hit trigger or recursively modify Inferno events.
The two-reduction threshold applies only to the original Barkscales incoming-damage counter; Tearing Thorns remains a five-DoT-hit counter.
The 8-tick cooldown applies only to Striking Light; Lord of Light retains its independent 24-tick cooldown.
